Atlas Crossing Partners Fund II exit IC memo recommending sale of Halcyon Pet Foods, Inc. to Cabrillo Holdings (Mars-affiliated) for $890M enterprise value (14.5x LTM Adj. EBITDA of $61.4M). The all-cash stock purchase transaction is targeting an April 14, 2023 close. Fund II invested $104M in equity (initial $95M in Sep 2017 + $9M bolt-on for Vesta Treats in Jun 2020) and expects cumulative proceeds of $355M (including $21M Q3 2021 dividend recap), yielding 3.5x gross MOIC and 28.4% gross IRR on a ~5.5-year hold. Net MOIC is 2.8x and net IRR is 23.1%. Key value creation drivers include DTC channel build (subscriber count grew 6.5x), organic revenue growth (51% of equity value creation), multiple expansion from 11.0x to 14.5x (29%), and the Vesta Treats bolt-on (8%). Revenue grew from $132M to $328M and EBITDA from $25.9M to $61.4M over the hold period. The memo notes three competing final bids and recommends Cabrillo for highest bid, all-cash structure, and strategic synergies with Mars global distribution.

Atlas Crossing Partners Fund I IC exit memo recommending the sale of Cardinal Filtration Co. to Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI) for $560M enterprise value (9.5x LTM Adj. EBITDA of $58.9M). The deal represents a 5.3-year hold from September 2014, delivering 3.2x gross MOIC and ~26.1% gross IRR (2.6x / 21.2% net). Entry thesis centered on industrial filtration roll-up was largely delivered: 4 bolt-ons completed, gross margin expanded 320bps, private-label penetration grew from 9% to 28%, and revenue scaled from $186M to $472M. Operating margin was flat (thesis miss due to bolt-on mix shift). Sale process run by Baird yielded three final bids; Donaldson selected at $560M all-cash, no financing condition.

Atlas Crossing Partners Fund I exit IC memo recommending the sale of Meridian Safety Systems, Inc. to Honeywell Safety Products for $268M enterprise value (9.4x LTM Adj. EBITDA of $28.4M). The transaction is an all-cash stock purchase with a target close of April 15, 2018. ACP invested $42M total equity (Oct 2012 platform + 3 bolt-ons) and realized gross proceeds of ~$141.8M, generating 2.8x gross MOIC and ~22.4% gross IRR over a 5.5-year hold. The investment exceeded its base-case underwrite of 2.5x MOIC. Value creation was driven by organic growth (43%), bolt-on acquisitions (31%), multiple expansion from 6.6x to 9.4x (23%), and FCF/debt paydown (3%). Three bolt-ons (Central States Safety Supply, Appalachian PPE Distributors, Gulf Coast Safety Group) were fully integrated. Revenue grew from $72M to $198M and EBITDA from $9.0M to $28.4M over the hold period.

Exit IC memo recommending the Investment Committee approve the sale of Precision Asset Inspections, Inc. to Bureau Veritas S.A. for $310M enterprise value (10.0x LTM Adj. EBITDA of $31.0M). Atlas Crossing Partners Fund II invested $48M in equity (Jan 2016 platform + 3 bolt-ons) and generated estimated total proceeds of $171M including escrow release, yielding a 3.0x gross MOIC and ~23.8% gross IRR over a 5.9-year hold. The company grew revenue from $52M to $142M and EBITDA from $9.4M to $31.0M, completed 3 geographic bolt-ons, commercialized the Vantage IQ SaaS platform to $8.2M ARR, and expanded recurring revenue from 38% to 68%. Bureau Veritas was selected from three final bids as highest value, all-cash with fastest close, with CEO and CTO rolling 4% of EV into the BV vehicle.
